task.title: Operate the documentation assistant in BPM 0.9.4
task.shortdesc: Verify the released training-notice boundary without making BPM or deterministic documentation search dependent on the chat.

prereq.p: Use a supported BPM 0.9.4 source checkout and the base system capacity in .

context.p: In this release the chat is a localized reader interface only. It does not start or install a model, retrieve documentation, use an E5 index, generate an answer, expose citations, or contact external sources. Deterministic documentation search remains separate and available.

step.cmd: Start BPM by using the normal supported source workflow.

info.p: Do not add model, index, embedding, or external-provider setup to BPM startup for release 0.9.4.

step.cmd: Open the documentation portal in the reader’s locale.

info.p: Confirm that the assistant can be opened from the lower-right corner without changing the ordinary search controls.
The transcript must show the localized notice that local-model training is in progress and will be available in a later version.
The same notice is expected; the chat is not a general-purpose assistant in this release.

step.cmd: Use deterministic documentation search to find the current answer.

info.p: Search, filters, navigation, and result ordering remain the supported product-information path.

result.p: The assistant presents the released localized training notice, while BPM and deterministic documentation search remain independently usable.

postreq.p: Do not install a model or build a RAG generation for 0.9.4. Record a documentation defect if the notice, locale, or ordinary search boundary differs from this behavior.
